events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, turns 54.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite tune from the legendary frontman?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring his signature song, was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album that gave us a timeless anthem for peace and hope. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: Apple launched the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music players, in 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, which 007 moment is your absolute favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder and solo artist John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated comedian, actor, and Monty Python co-founder John Cleese marks his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A Master of Comedy
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is unparalleled. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'The White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double LP, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in 1968.

angles.name: Revolutionary Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to rock the world. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in 1965.

angles.name: A Creative Leap
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul' – an album that marked a significant evolution in their sound and songwriting. Which track from this classic stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: A Legacy of Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever. We remember a true visionary.
